sections.theory:
Proof:

By definition s^2=\frac{1}{n-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\overline{X})^2

$(n-1)\,s^2=\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\overline{X})^2$

=\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\mu+\mu-\overline{X})^2 i.e. μ is added and subtracted

=\sum_{i=1}^{n}[(X_i-\mu)-(\overline{X}-\mu)]^2

=\sum_{i=1}^{n}[(X_i-\mu)^2+(\overline{X}-\mu)^2-2(X_i-\mu)(\overline{X}-\mu)]

=\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\mu)^2+n(\overline{X}-\mu)^2-2(\overline{X}-\mu)\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\mu)

=\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\mu)^2+n(\overline{X}-\mu)^2-2(\overline{X}-\mu)\,n(\overline{X}-\mu) As \sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\mu)=n(\overline{X}-\mu)

=\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\mu)^2+n(\overline{X}-\mu)^2-2n(\overline{X}-\mu)^2

=\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\mu)^2-n(\overline{X}-\mu)^2

Now taking expectation on both sides

$(n-1)\,E(s^2)=n\,E(X_i-\mu)^2-n\,E(\overline{X}-\mu)^2$

=n\sigma^2-n\sigma_{\overline{x}}^2 As \sigma_{\overline{x}}^2=\frac{\sigma^2}{n}

=(n-1)\sigma^2

E(s^2)=\sigma^2

This implies that s^2=\frac{1}{n-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\overline{X})^2 is an unbiased estimator of \sigma^2.

sections.theory:
Example 6.5

Draw all possible samples of size 2 with replacement from a population having elements 4, 8, 12, 16 and show that;

i) E(\overline{X})=\mu i.e. \overline{X} is an unbiased estimator of μ.

ii) E(s^2)=\sigma^2 i.e. s^2=\frac{1}{n-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\overline{X})^2 is an unbiased estimator of \sigma^2.

iii) E(S^2)\neq\sigma^2 i.e S^2=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\overline{X})^2 is a biased estimator of \sigma^2.

Solution:

Given 4, 8, 12, 16; N = 4; and n = 2

Population mean \mu=\frac{\Sigma X}{N}=\frac{4+8+12+16}{4}=\frac{40}{4}=10

Population variance \sigma^2=\frac{\Sigma X^2}{N}-\left(\frac{\Sigma X}{N}\right)^2=\frac{480}{4}-\left(\frac{40}{4}\right)^2=20

مثال 6.5

عناصر 4، 8، 12، 16 والی آبادی سے واپسی کے ساتھ 2 سائز کے تمام ممکنہ نمونے نکالیں اور ثابت کریں کہ؛

i) E(\overline{X})=\mu یعنی \overline{X}، μ کا غیر جانبدار تخمین کار ہے۔

ii) E(s^2)=\sigma^2 یعنی s^2=\frac{1}{n-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\overline{X})^2، \sigma^2 کا غیر جانبدار تخمین کار ہے۔

iii) E(S^2)\neq\sigma^2 یعنی S^2=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i-\overline{X})^2، \sigma^2 کا جانبدار تخمین کار ہے۔

حل:

دیا گیا ہے 4، 8، 12، 16؛ N = 4؛ اور n = 2

آبادی کا اوسط \mu=\frac{\Sigma X}{N}=\frac{4+8+12+16}{4}=\frac{40}{4}=10

آبادی کا تغیر \sigma^2=\frac{\Sigma X^2}{N}-\left(\frac{\Sigma X}{N}\right)^2=\frac{480}{4}-\left(\frac{40}{4}\right)^2=20
